header: The page's plan for N64Recomp-browser's tools/play_page.mjs, its regular play of 2-3 minutes: the launcher, Load ROM
on a new profile once the shader list Chrome builds behind the launcher is done (Firefox builds none there, and its
line saying so is the one waited for), Start Game, the boot and the intro story to the title with Start (Enter). There
tools/shader_survey.js's demo() starts the attract demo as the title's wait does, and the plan watches its first
scenes, Koopa Village and the demo's first battle, before Start ends it at the title. Then Start to file select, and
A (Space) on the first file, its name and its confirmation, as a player does, to a new game's first map. From there
the survey's warp() goes to Toad Town (mac_00) as an exit does, at the story's start of chapter 1, behind a need that
fails the run unless it plays, and Mario walks it with the stick (WASD) for half a minute of the game's time on its
clock (gGameStatus.frameCounter, 30 a second), then the pause menu with Start and out of it, then Koopa Village
(nok_01) the same way. The game mode is CurGameMode (0x800A08F0, its high half). tools/play_plan_extended.json goes
on to more areas, for when a longer play is needed.
